title: Denial at the meeting at Swedish military headquarters

tellings.quote: And he just look at me. "No, no, no, no, no. We have not been there." "But you have been filming you. I have filmed you. So, I know you have been there."

plain: In 2011, at the Swedish military headquarters in Stockholm, a treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg says an officer flatly denied that the military had visited the site on the seafloor where Asberg's team had found a strange object. Asberg says he answered, "I have filmed you. So, I know you have been there." He tells it as something he lived through, as a sign that the military was quietly interested in what he believes may be a UFO on the seafloor.
